original.statement: From chart 0.15.0 to 0.16.0, the storage version of clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io moves from v1beta1 to v1. Existing ClusterSecretStore objects need a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update before a later release removes v1beta1.

decision.reason: [ev-d55f4ac0a53f] shows that from 0.15.0 to 0.16.0, the clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io CRD's spec.versions[name=v1beta1].storage flipped from true to false. That is the storage-version change in the title. The upstream change text says existing ClusterSecretStore objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten and that a storage version migration must be run before a later release removes v1beta1. So a migration subject with change type migration-required fits. The name 'clustersecretstores-storage-version-migration' is kebab-case built from the evidence's own words and names the CRD it applies to, so it should not be put in a component field.
